name: Pipeliners - Buckeye Change Tracking 2026-09-30
body:
> Tracker · Pipeliners · 2026-09-30

# Summary
Tracking note for https://pipelinersusa.com/buckeye/. Kim updated the page around Sep 22-26 (exact date and change to be confirmed); WordPress still showed last modified Sep 1, so the edit may have gone through OTTO.

# Baseline (GSC US via Search Atlas)
- Aug 4 to Aug 31: 365 impressions, position 18, 0 clicks.
- Sep 2 to Sep 28: 397 impressions, position 19, 0 clicks.
- Sep 8 to Sep 21: 315 impressions, position 18.
- After the Sep 1 edit the page began ranking for sewer terms (trenchless sewer repair buckeye az #9, trenchless sewer line replacement #10, sewer line repair #12).
- Top keywords: buckeye az pipe break repair (81 impressions, 14), buckeye az water line repair (53, 20), pipe breaks buckeye az (45, 24), buckeye gas line repair (43, 18, not a service).

# Live page Sep 30
Title "Trenchless Pipe Repair & Lining in Buckeye, AZ | Pipeliners", 2,199 words, one H2 still "Why Choose Pipeliners USA?".

# Success check
Recheck on or after Oct 10 with a 14-day before/after compare: impressions per 2 weeks above 315 and position better than 18; pipe break and water line terms moving toward page one. The handoff adds a fallback title if pipe-break terms stay on page 2. See also `performance-tracking\BUCKEYE-SEO-TEST.md` (owned by the audits index).
